title: 虎胆龙威
creator: John McTiernan
note: 把孤胆警探困进摩天楼，用地下室、电梯井与通风管道改写了好莱坞动作片的空间语法。
noteEn: Traps a lone cop inside a skyscraper, rewriting the spatial grammar of the Hollywood action film.

title: 终结者2：审判日
creator: James Cameron
note: 液态金属 T-1000 是全 CGI 角色的分水岭，动作与悲悯并存，续集片的天花板。
noteEn: The liquid-metal T-1000 set the bar for CGI characters; spectacle and melancholy in one sequel.

title: 黑客帝国
creator: Lana & Lilly Wachowski
note: 子弹时间把功夫与哲学缝进同一帧，让每个观众都开始怀疑眼前的红蓝药丸。
noteEn: Bullet time fused kung fu and philosophy into one frame, making us all question the pill.

title: 疯狂的麦克斯4：狂暴之路
creator: George Miller
note: 两小时不间断的沙漠追车芭蕾，实拍特效的极致，反乌托邦的女性主义寓言。
noteEn: Two hours of non-stop desert chase ballet, practical effects at their peak, a feminist dystopian fable.

title: 疾速追杀
creator: Chad Stahelski
note: 为一条狗复仇的退役杀手，以枪斗术和霓虹美学重造了动作片的节奏感。
noteEn: A retired hitman avenging his dog, redefining action rhythm with gun-fu and neon style.

title: 突袭
creator: Gareth Evans
note: 印尼武打片的一记重拳，把整栋黑帮大楼变成擂台，Pencak Silat 格斗教科书。
noteEn: A punch of Indonesian action, turning a gang tower block into a ring — a pencak silat textbook.

title: 警察故事
creator: Jackie Chan
note: 成龙的搏命肉身喜剧，商场滑梯与巴士跳车戏至今无人敢照搬。
noteEn: Jackie Chan's suicidal stunt comedy — the mall slide and bus jump remain unmatched.

title: 辣手神探
creator: John Woo
note: 吴宇森英雄片暴力美学的终点站，医院枪战一镜到底的奇观。
noteEn: John Woo's heroic-bloodshed crescendo, capped by the legendary single-take hospital shootout.

title: 龙争虎斗
creator: Robert Clouse
note: 李小龙的好莱坞破冰之作，把功夫带上国际银幕的类型总动员。
noteEn: Bruce Lee's Hollywood breakthrough that brought kung fu to the world's screens.

title: 叶问
creator: Wilson Yip
note: 甄子丹十连击咏春拳，把一代宗师的儒雅与家国尊严打在银幕上。
noteEn: Donnie Yen's ten-hit Wing Chun, projecting the master's poise and national dignity.

title: 卧虎藏龙
creator: Ang Lee
note: 飞檐走壁的武侠想像配西方古典乐，让东方侠义美学拿下奥斯卡外语片。
noteEn: Wire-fu wuxia romance set to Western classical music, winning the Oscar for foreign film.

title: 英雄
creator: 张艺谋
note: 以色彩分章的刺客寓言，把书法、古琴与天下观熔进武侠的骨血。
noteEn: A color-coded assassin fable folding calligraphy, zither and 'all under heaven' into wuxia.

title: 角斗士
creator: Ridley Scott
note: 古罗马角斗场的复仇史诗，罗素·克劳用剑与泪重振了剑与凉鞋类型。
noteEn: A Roman revenge epic that revived the sword-and-sandal genre with Russell Crowe's sword and tears.

title: 飓风营救
creator: Pierre Morel
note: 一句'我会找到你'的电话台词，让连姆·尼森成为最优雅的暴怒父亲。
noteEn: A single phone line — 'I will find you' — turned Liam Neeson into cinema's most elegant fury.

title: 碟中谍6：全面瓦解
creator: Christopher McQuarrie
note: 阿汤哥亲自跳直升机与 HALO 跳伞，实拍特技堆出好莱坞最后的奇观主义。
noteEn: Cruise really jumps from a helicopter and free-falls in HALO — practical stunts as final spectacle.

title: 谍影重重3
creator: Paul Greengrass
note: 手持摄影的晃动美学终结了谍战片的西装雅痞，杰森·伯恩是当代动作语法的转折点。
noteEn: Shaky-cam realism killed the tuxedo spy; Jason Bourne is the pivot of modern action grammar.

title: 杀死比尔1
creator: Quentin Tarantino
note: 血溅五尺的武士刀与黄黑连体衣，昆汀写给邵氏与日本剑戟片的情书。
noteEn: Samurai blades, geysers of blood and the yellow jumpsuit — Tarantino's love letter to Shaw Brothers and chanbara.

title: 变脸
creator: John Woo
note: 换脸设定让正邪在两张皮囊里互换，吴宇森的好莱坞巅峰与双雄宿命论。
noteEn: Facial transplants swap hero and villain — Woo's Hollywood peak and his fated-duel obsession.

title: 生死时速
creator: Jan de Bont
note: 一列不能低于五十英里的公交车，把高概念悬念焊死在轮子上。
noteEn: A bus that must stay above fifty — high-concept suspense welded to four wheels.

title: 极盗车神
creator: Edgar Wright
note: 追逐戏与流行金曲精准卡拍的音画同步，让汽车追逐有了节奏与乐感。
noteEn: Chases choreographed to pop tunes — car chases finally have rhythm and pitch.

title: 蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士
creator: Christopher Nolan
note: 希斯·莱杰的小丑把超级英雄片拖进道德深渊，犯罪戏码比动作更惊心。
noteEn: Ledger's Joker drags the superhero film into a moral abyss; the crime beats outshine the action.

title: 壮志凌云2：独行侠
creator: Joseph Kosinski
note: 实拍 F-18 驾驶舱与 IMAX 空战，让三十五年后的续集比前作更酣畅。
noteEn: Real F-18 cockpits and IMAX dogfights make the 35-years-later sequel out-fly its original.

title: 英雄本色
creator: John Woo
note: 周润发风衣墨镜的双枪场面开启英雄片潮流，定义了八九十年代香港黑帮浪漫。
noteEn: Chow Yun-fat's trench-coat gun ballet launched the heroic-bloodshed wave and defined HK gangster romance.

title: 好家伙
creator: Martin Scorsese
note: 推拉镜头与旁白把黑帮日常拍成摇滚乐，叙述者视角的犯罪片圣经。
noteEn: Steadicam and voiceover turn gangster life into rock 'n' roll — the narrator's-eye crime bible.

title: 低俗小说
creator: Quentin Tarantino
note: 环形叙事把三个黑色故事拧成一团，台词与配乐成为九零年代流行文化代名词。
noteEn: Circular storytelling braids three tales; its dialogue and soundtrack defined '90s pop culture.

title: 落水狗
creator: Quentin Tarantino
note: 一场被提前揭晓的抢劫、六个互不信任的代号者，昆汀处女作即奠定黑色幽默。
noteEn: A heist already gone wrong and six distrustful colors — Tarantino's debut set his noir-comic tone.

title: 盗火线
creator: Michael Mann
note: 德尼罗与帕西诺首度同框的枪战对谈，把警匪片拍成都市悲剧双人舞。
noteEn: De Niro and Pacino finally face off — cop and robber as a tragic urban pas de deux.

title: 无间道风云
creator: Martin Scorsese
note: 波士顿警匪双面卧底，双线绞杀让老马丁终于捧起最佳影片小金人。
noteEn: Two moles at war in Boston — the double-agent duel that finally won Scorsese his Best Picture.

title: 无间道
creator: 刘伟强 / 麦兆辉
note: 卧底与黑警的双面人生，港片巅峰的细腻剪辑后来被好莱坞直接翻拍。
noteEn: A cop in the mob, a mole in the police — HK's taut duel that Hollywood later remade.

title: 铁面无私
creator: Brian De Palma
note: 车站婴儿车阶梯枪战致敬《战舰波将金号》，禁酒令年代的黑帮正典。
noteEn: The pram-on-the-stairs shootout salutes Battleship Potemkin — a Prohibition-era classic.

title: 疤面煞星
creator: Brian De Palma
note: '小个子'的野心直到那句'Say hello to my little friend'，黑帮堕落的巴洛克寓言。
noteEn: A little man's greed all the way to 'Say hello to my little friend' — a baroque fable of downfall.

title: 这个杀手不太冷
creator: Luc Besson
note: 冷面杀手与孤女玛蒂尔达的忘年羁绊，让暴力片里长出最温柔的花。
noteEn: A hitman and a twelve-year-old orphan's bond — tenderness blooming inside a violent thriller.

title: 热天午后
creator: Sidney Lumet
note: 阿尔·帕西诺的银行劫案即兴表演，把荒诞现实拍成令人窒息的群像剧。
noteEn: Pacino's bank-job improv turns absurd reality into a suffocating ensemble drama.

title: 偷拐抢骗
creator: Guy Ritchie
note: 伦敦底层各色人等的钻石与拳赛闹剧，多线剪辑的英伦痞气范本。
noteEn: A diamond, a bare-knuckle fight and London's underworld — British cheek in braided timelines.

title: 两杆大烟枪
en: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
creator: Guy Ritchie
note: 一张做局的扑克牌引发连锁黑吃黑，盖·里奇处女作定义了英式酷炫群像。
noteEn: One rigged poker hand sets off a chain of double-crosses — Ritchie's debut of British cool.

title: 非常嫌疑犯
creator: Bryan Singer
note: 凯撒·苏尔的名字在最后一刻改写整个故事，叙事诡计的教科书。
noteEn: The name Kaiser Soze rewrites everything at the last minute — a textbook narrative trick.

title: 杀人回忆
creator: Bong Joon-ho
note: 改编自华城连环案的乡野追凶，在时代之踵里看见荒诞与无力。
noteEn: Rural detectives chase Korea's first serial killer — absurdity and helplessness inside a time of trauma.

title: 甜蜜的人生
creator: Kim Jee-woon
note: 向老板的女人多看一眼就万劫不复，金知云的风格化暴力与宿命美学。
noteEn: One glance at the boss's girl seals a stylish doom — Kim Jee-woon's stylized violence.

title: 赌城风云
creator: Martin Scorsese
note: 拉斯维加斯的黄金时代与倾覆，赌场黑帮权力之巅最喧哗的挽歌。
noteEn: The rise and fall of Vegas's golden age — the loudest dirge for casino-era power.

title: 花火
creator: Takeshi Kitano
note: 北野武把暴力剪成顿挫的诗句，把对垂死妻子的温柔画进每一帧。
noteEn: Kitano cuts violence into staccato poetry and paints tenderness for a dying wife into every frame.

title: 七宗罪
creator: David Fincher
note: 七宗罪连环凶杀，雨夜城市的下水道里藏着最后一个'愤怒'的盒子。
noteEn: A seven-sins killer in a rain-soaked city — the final box holds one last 'wrath'.

title: 沉默的羔羊
creator: Jonathan Demme
note: 史达琳与汉尼拔的隔栏对话，让心理惊悚成为横扫五座奥斯卡的经典。
noteEn: Clarice's cage-side talks with Hannibal made psychological horror sweep five Oscars.

title: 消失的爱人
creator: David Fincher
note: 反转婚姻惊悚，把媒体狂欢与性别博弈一层层剥给人看。
noteEn: A marriage thriller that flips into a media circus — a scalpel on gender and spectacle.

title: 囚徒
creator: Denis Villeneuve
note: 两个女孩失踪引爆小镇的道德崩解，雨夜里的信仰与私刑纠缠。
noteEn: Two missing girls crack a town's morality — faith and vigilantism tangled in the rain.

title: 十二宫
creator: David Fincher
note: 用报社编辑的执念还原未破悬案，克制而绵长的数字时代前奏。
noteEn: A cartoonist's obsession maps an unsolved case — a patient, procedural pre-internet thriller.

title: 西北偏北
creator: Alfred Hitchcock
note: 被误认身份的好人一路狂奔，从玉米田农药机到总统山攀岩的经典追逐。
noteEn: A man mistaken and on the run — crop-duster strafing and Mount Rushmore define the chase.

title: 后窗
creator: Alfred Hitchcock
note: 把偷窥拍成观众的道德困境，整部戏困在一扇窗前的凝视奇观。
noteEn: Voyeurism as moral trap — an entire thriller staged inside one window's gaze.

title: 迷魂记
creator: Alfred Hitchcock
note: 螺旋式镜头与痴恋轮回，被影评人奉为电影语言本身的爱情暗面。
noteEn: The dolly-zoom spiral of obsession — critics' pick for cinema's own dark love language.

title: 第六感
creator: M. Night Shyamalan
note: 'I see dead people'后的反转改写全片，儿童心理与鬼故事温柔相遇。
noteEn: The twist behind 'I see dead people' rewrites the film — a gentle ghost story of a boy's pain.

title: 记忆碎片
creator: Christopher Nolan
note: 倒叙剪辑模拟失忆者的时间感，纹身是记忆也是自我欺骗。
noteEn: Backward editing mimics a man with no short-term memory — tattoos as memory and self-deceit.

title: 致命魔术
creator: Christopher Nolan
note: 两个魔术师以命相博的骗局，电影本身就是最大的障眼法。
noteEn: Two magicians destroying each other for one trick — the film itself is the ultimate misdirection.

title: 盗梦空间
creator: Christopher Nolan
note: 梦中梦的陀螺永不停转，把潜入梦境的盗贼故事拍成视觉与概念的双重迷宫。
noteEn: Dreams within dreams and a spinning top — a heist inside the mind as visual and conceptual maze.

title: 龙纹身的女孩
en: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
creator: David Fincher
note: 黑客少女与记者的北欧悬案联手，冰冷雪原下的家族罪恶被一点点掘开。
noteEn: A hacker and a journalist dig into a cold Nordic family's buried crimes.

title: 追击者
creator: Na Hong-jin
note: 皮条客追凶却屡屡擦肩而过，韩国新黑色电影把无力感拧到窒息。
noteEn: A pimp hunting a killer he keeps missing — Korean neo-noir tightening helplessness to suffocation.

title: 禁闭岛
creator: Martin Scorsese
note: 精神病院的迷宫叙事，真相与幻觉在风暴中的灯塔里对峙。
noteEn: A mental-hospital labyrinth — truth and delusion face off in a lighthouse amid the storm.

title: 边境杀手
creator: Denis Villeneuve
note: 美墨边境的灰色地带，'墙'上开出的不是正义而是纪律化的邪恶。
noteEn: The moral grey of the border — the 'wall' grows disciplined evil, not justice.

title: 夜行者
creator: Dan Gilroy
note: 把新闻底线熬成商业野心的吉伦哈尔，病态魅力照出现代媒体的镜像。
noteEn: Gyllenhaal's sociopath selling blood-soaked footage — a mirror held to modern media.

title: 唐人街
creator: Roman Polanski
note: 水权阴谋与乱伦阴影下的黑色侦探史诗，'唐人街'三个字就是全片的注脚。
noteEn: A noir detective epic of water rights and incest — 'Chinatown' is the film's entire footnote.

title: 马耳他之鹰
creator: John Huston
note: 萨姆·斯佩德与一群谎言的猎手，猎物的猎鹰雕像是虚无本身。
noteEn: Sam Spade vs. a nest of liars — the falcon statuette turns out to be nothing at all.

title: 双重赔偿
creator: Billy Wilder
note: 保险理赔员与蛇蝎美人的杀夫计划，黑色电影蛇蝎美人原型的奠基作。
noteEn: An insurance man and a femme fatale plot murder — the archetypal blueprint of noir.

title: 日落大道
creator: Billy Wilder
note: 过气默片女星用游泳池收留落魄编剧，好莱坞对自己最刻薄的挽歌。
noteEn: A faded silent star keeps a hack writer in her pool — Hollywood's cruellest self-elegy.

title: 夜长梦多
creator: Howard Hawks
note: 情节本就混沌，鲍嘉与芭考尔的化学反应就是全部逻辑。
noteEn: The plot barely matters — Bogart and Bacall's chemistry is the whole logic.

title: 历劫佳人
creator: Orson Welles
note: 三分钟一镜到底的边境开场，威尔斯用胖警察的丑陋肉身拍尽腐败。
noteEn: A legendary three-minute opening take; Welles embodies corruption in one fat cop.

title: 第三个人
creator: Carol Reed
note: 战后维也纳的下水道与旋转木马，齐特琴声里藏着最著名的'不存在'第三个人。
noteEn: Post-war Vienna's sewers and ferris wheel — a zither score for cinema's most famous absent man.

title: 洛城机密
creator: Curtis Hanson
note: 五十年代洛杉矶的杂志光鲜与警察黑幕，黑色电影的九零年代复兴范本。
noteEn: Glossy '50s LA vs. corrupt cops — the blueprint for the '90s neo-noir revival.

title: 银翼杀手
creator: Ridley Scott
note: 复制人的雨夜哭泣与雨中独白，把黑色侦探放进霓虹的未来洛杉矶。
noteEn: Replicants weeping in acid rain — a noir detective dropped into neon-future LA.

title: 银翼杀手2049
creator: Denis Villeneuve
note: 延续原作的存在主义追问，橙灰两色的末日摄影拿下奥斯卡。
noteEn: The existential question continues — its burnt-orange cinematography earned an Oscar.

title: 罪恶之城
creator: Robert Rodriguez / Frank Miller
note: 把漫画分镜直接搬上银幕的黑白高反差，雨滴与血珠都颗粒分明。
noteEn: Comic panels brought to screen in stark black and white — every raindrop and blood bead visible.

title: M就是凶手
creator: Fritz Lang
note: 以口哨与气球追踪恋童凶手的德国前法典之作，黑帮与警察联手审判。
noteEn: A killer hunted by whistle and balloon in pre-Code Germany — mob and police hold court together.

title: 杀手
creator: Stanley Kubrick
note: 赛马场劫案的多线时间回环，库布里克用剪辑把宿命拆成碎片。
noteEn: A racetrack heist in nonlinear fragments — Kubrick's editing turns fate into splinters.

title: 漩涡之外
creator: Jacques Tourneur
note: 过去的女人追着私家侦探不放，黑色电影宿命论的完美缩影。
noteEn: The past in a femme fatale won't let a private eye go — noir fatalism in miniature.

title: 穆赫兰道
creator: David Lynch
note: 梦与好莱坞的两半拼图，林奇把失落与欲望拼成无法合拢的蓝盒子。
noteEn: Hollywood dream and nightmare in two halves — Lynch's blue box never quite closes.

title: 亡命驾驶
creator: Nicolas Winding Refn
note: 粉字霓虹下近乎沉默的司机，把复古合成器与暴力反差推到极致。
noteEn: A near-silent wheelman under pink neon — synthwave score against bursts of brutality.

title: 追凶
creator: Rian Johnson
note: 把黑色电影对白塞进高中校园，少年侦探在储物柜间追查毒品谜案。
noteEn: Hard-boiled dialogue transplanted to high school — a teen detective hunts through lockers.

title: 漫长的告别
creator: Robert Altman
note: 把马洛拖进七十年代嬉皮洛杉矶，一只流浪猫与一支口琴的松弛孤独。
noteEn: Philip Marlowe lost in '70s LA — a stray cat and a harmonica's easy-going loneliness.

title: 独行杀手
creator: Jean-Pierre Melville
note: 阿兰·德龙的帽檐与风衣，极简到近乎禅意的杀手仪式，无数杀手片的源头。
noteEn: Delon's hat and trench coat in a near-silent ritual — the wellspring of every hitman film.
